# I Love Pole Because

> A community site collecting real people's stories about why they love pole dancing — fitness, community, and self-expression.

A companion project of Pole Fitness Studio (Las Vegas) and PoleFitnessOnline.com. Visitors share their stories; new pole dancers get a free first class in Las Vegas.

## Pages

- [Stories](/stories): Personal stories from the pole community
- [Share Your Story](/share-your-story): Tell us why you love pole dancing
